entries.content: Mensavati is a English-speaking county placed in the USA, near Texas. It had three elementary schools, three middle schools, and two high schools. It was very rural, so there were farm plots, work was plentiful and paid. It had a single library, that was funded by the government. It got reduced to irradiated rubble in the Mexico-America War.

The Mexico-America War is a war between Mexico and the United States of America, it had a total death toll ranging in the millions, most of the dead being civilian lives. It resulted in Mexico being put under United Nation dissolution and USA losing Texas as a habitable area. Though that doesn't stop people from checking Texas out. It was a conflict that took place during World War Three.

Texas is an irradiated desert, it is protected by a combined effort of Mexico's and USA's respective Military. However, due to the rumors that surround the area of the cloaked being wandering the wasteland, people still head to the area to attempt to see the cloaked figure. The cloaked figure is also rumored to be Death or The Grim Reaper, many believe The Mexico-America War was simply a cover up to prevent the world knowing the physical location of the manifestation of death.

Lotus dulls the body's pain response and changes most pains into a pleasurable sensation, things that are normally pleasurable are near-euphoric. Lotus lasts for fourteen hours in the body, is fat and water soluble. It is possible to get dosed on Lotus through the body fluids of someone else if they have used it within the first two hours.

Lotus pills look like lotus flowers, but can be in an almost white-pink dust form as well.

entries.content:
The Creator of Man and the universe that inhabits Man, through the passage of time HE has become no more than a fable to Man. HE did treat Man as his sons and daughter, but HE eventually left. HE will return some day, perhaps after the sun kills Man, perhaps just before. Only HE knows, but the men and women that still believe in The LORD, see and hear his signs.

The Signs of HE, The LORD, are eyes in the clouds and whispers in the wind. The signs are everywhere, inescapable. Rarely those who are not believers of HE see his signs or hear them, breaking them to temporary madness.

World War Three lasted only a week, while the conflicts that comprised it lasted for two years. It wasn't a full scale world war, just a time where most of the developed nations got rowdy and started throwing punches. It included The Mexico-America War, The Ukraine-Russia War, The Korean War, The Taiwan-China Conflict, The Israel-Palestine Conflict, and a few civil wars in Africa.

It was stopped by God on the seventh day, God's Divine Intervention turned a few places into radioactive deserts by His Touch.

Before God left Man, HE granted them the Divinity of Image. Allowing Man to take limited shape suited to their internal image with refinement from external view. Such, Man sprouted features that belong to animals or artificial creations.
